visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair wearing a tan jacket sits in an office chair at a red desk in a clinic-like setting, looking at a computer monitor that displays a macro image of human skin. (2) Close-up macro shots of human skin with visible red blemishes and acne-like spots are shown, featuring white graphic circles, pointing hand icons, and purple graphic lines indicating specific areas of concern. (3) A brief cutaway shows a young man wearing glasses looking into a mirror and using his fingers to squeeze a blemish on his cheek in a dimly lit bathroom environment. (4) The scene returns to the woman in the tan jacket sitting at the desk; she gestures with her right hand while speaking, her head turned toward the monitor which shows a skin analysis. (5) A 3D scientific animation appears on screen, depicting microscopic yellow, grape-like clusters representing Demodex mites residing inside a pink tubular structure that mimics a human hair follicle. (6) Multiple macro images of skin with pigmentation and active inflammation are cycled through, with red graphic circles highlighting specific bumps and dark spots on the skin surface. (7) A white professional medical laser machine labeled 'UltraPulse' is superimposed over the office scene, showing its digital interface screen and the articulated arm used for dermatological treatments. (8) A circular graphic speech bubble appears in the lower corner featuring a headshot of a female doctor with glasses and a white lab coat, smiling against a clean grey background. (9) The main woman at the desk continues her explanation, gesturing towards the screen and medical documents while sitting in a professional clinic workspace with a tan shawl draped over her chair. (10) The video concludes with a full-screen white graphic overlay displaying the clinic's logo, 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC', along with social media handles, phone numbers, and addresses for branches in Sanchong and Taipei.
